mapper.sql: id, product_id, spec_name, flavor, package_size, price, stock, image_url, status, create_time, update_time
mapper.select: SELECT FROM product_sku WHERE product_id = #{productId} ORDER BY id ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO product_sku (product_id, spec_name, flavor, package_size, price, stock, image_url, status, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{productId}, #{specName}, #{flavor}, #{packageSize}, #{price}, #{stock}, #{imageUrl}, COALESCE(#{status}, 1), NOW(), NOW())
